results.description:
This episode explores how philosophy can help us notice more of life before it passes. 
John O’Donohue and Rilke encourage us to rediscover the beauty of ordinary surroundings, while Seneca asks us to consider how much of our limited time disappears into distraction, busyness, and postponement. 
Together, their reflections suggest that living well is not simply about making better use of time, but about being present for the life already unfolding around us.
If you’d like to practice these principles, this Micro Morning Meditation will be helpful:
☀️ Micro Morning Meditation: Nature Awaits Your Appreciation
https://whatisstoicism.substack.com/p/micro-morning-meditation-nature-awaits

results.description:
In this episode, discover how true power stems from learning to understand and control your emotions. Through the wisdom of Stoicism, you will gain tools to remain calm in the face of adversity, master your impulses, respond intelligently, and prevent external circumstances from governing your mind. Learn to transform frustration into strength, fear into courage, and uncertainty into serenity. Remember: being strong does not mean not feeling; rather, it means knowing how to act even when your emotions challenge you.
